title: LUX Health Villa near Old Town Scottsdale
description: A stunning estate that has it all and is just minutes away from Old Town Scottsdale! Lounge poolside, soak in the hot tub, unwind in the sauna, or rally on the private pickleball court, basketball court, bowling, golf, or chess! Inside the modern expansive home, you'll find a speakeasy poker lounge, movie theater, and arcades w/ over a 1,000 games! Stunning mountain views, vibrant design, and endless luxury amenities throughout, this home is the ultimate vacation home!
